data_disclosure: No original project files uploaded to Biomni; targeted methods discussion only.
accepted: Quantify native-depth images; treat AVI renderings as linked derivatives, not independent observations.
Use native axes and acquisition timestamps. Separate time series, static images and z-stacks.
Keep culture, acquisition, field/region and frame units distinct; no frame/cell p-values.
Use transmitted-light information for region selection, avoiding fluorescence-selected masks.
Retain native-intensity, estimated-background, clipping, focus and motion diagnostics with source provenance.
Interpret recording-relative intensity changes without claiming a documented cadmium-addition event or calibrated binding.

adapted_or_rejected.recommendation: Read every ND2 using two independent readers.
adapted_or_rejected.decision: One pinned ND2 reader is used. Its event clocks are checked against native per-frame metadata; dimensions, channels and export correspondences are checked separately. This is not claimed to be an independent two-reader validation.

adapted_or_rejected.recommendation: Flag/exclude saturated cell ROIs; register rigid drift below approximately 0.5 pixels and otherwise exclude.
adapted_or_rejected.decision: Report measured clipping and motion and their impact per recording. Arbitrary universal exclusion thresholds are not adopted; no automatic reconstruction of clipped intensities is performed.

adapted_or_rejected.recommendation: Fit and correct an exponential bleaching trend.
adapted_or_rejected.decision: Do not subtract an assumed bleaching process from a possible biological fluorescence trend without a validated reference. Retain and describe the recorded trend.

adapted_or_rejected.recommendation: Calculate cell-level metrics after transmitted-light segmentation and overlay quality control.
adapted_or_rejected.decision: The reviewed brightfield masks contain partial cell rims and miss clumps. Treat them as brightfield-derived regions and sensitivity diagnostics; dense-field segmentation is not certified as a cell count or single-cell assay.

adapted_or_rejected.recommendation: Local extension to the generic review: resolve conflicting TIFF embedded timestamp blocks and ImageJ interval metadata.
adapted_or_rejected.decision: Six ImageJ intervals match stride-three reconstruction to float32 precision, supporting three-position interleaving. Pixel-to-clock mapping is not independently retained in the exports. Report the mapping as an explicit reconstruction assumption and preserve frame-index results.
